# Dorothy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P31](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0031), [v3 ch.Weddings P1](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Dorothy has lively hazel eyes.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Dorothy Lisle is a slender individual with a cheerful disposition. She is also described as being somewhat boyish.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## History

As the only family member [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) opens up to, Dorothy visited Nell's house alongside her family. During this visit, which was marked by several awkward moments involving her mother and Aline, Dorothy connected warmly with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P30](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0030), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P32](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0032)_

## Relationships

### [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cyril-lisle--dorothy.md)

[Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) is Dorothy's brother. He arranges for his family to visit [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), which leads to Dorothy traveling with them and meeting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) early. [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) is also present during the subsequent social gatherings surrounding [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her friends.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), +3 more_

- Sibling of — sister  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--nell-harcourt.md)

Dorothy is a friend of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). The two first met when Cyril's family unexpectedly arrived a day early to visit [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), an awkward visit during which Dorothy managed to connect warmly with her. Their friendship established a positive bond despite the chaotic circumstances of that initial meeting.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), +4 more_

- Friend of — friends  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P32](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0032), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.Weddings P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)</sub>
